headline: The valid-empty claim is now a machinery ceiling enforced at two independent surfaces, and the participant-role ceiling is a positive per-family allowlist rather than a blacklist.

enforced_at.refusal: semantic_family is not authorable in this tranche
registry build refuses authorable-in-tranche family; it is a required-valid-empty family
enforced_at.why_both: A single enforcement point is bypassable by hand-constructing a GovernedRule. Two independent surfaces make the ceiling a property of the machinery rather than of any one entry point.

valid_empty_is_still_lawful.distinguished_from_integrity_failure: TD_R03 §12 requires the valid-empty state to be distinguishable from missing/corrupt input, schema failure, duplicate ID, hash failure or other construction failure. A family refused by this ceiling is a CONSTRUCTION REFUSAL with a typed reason, not a validity failure.

why_each_family_is_closed.V556_INTERACTION_RELATION: TD_R03 §5 forbids an F1 constituted solely by coexistence, shared channel/mediator, or parallel occurrence. TD_R03 §6 records that no complete governed V556 interaction-rule authority was found. AUTHORIZED_INTERACTION_RELATION_KINDS is empty, and no relation kind was fabricated to preserve a canary goal.
why_each_family_is_closed.V556_ATTRACTOR_PREREQUISITE: No governed attractor-prerequisite rule authority exists. HQ forbids fabricating one. The family remains supported and visible in unfilled_families.

family_ceiling.what_would_open_a_family: A new governed rule authority supplying an authorized value/kind vocabulary for that family. It is NOT a code flag, a parameter, or an edit to these constants.

role_ceiling.derivation_constraint: derived ONLY from already-authorized current material: the two participant roles the topology canary already used. No role name was invented to make the API look generic.
role_ceiling.totalness: An allowlist is total over the complement. Every label outside the map is refused regardless of whether it looks structural or actor-ish.

defence_in_depth_retained.status: retained but NOT the authority ceiling
defence_in_depth_retained.why_that_matters: For participant roles the allowlist subsumes the blacklist entirely, so the blacklist can no longer be the thing that makes the refusal claim true. It still governs string enum VALUES and exact-ref KINDS, where the allowlist does not apply.
defence_in_depth_retained.discriminating_witness: CIVIC_ASSOCIATION, an innocent-looking label naming no blocked token, is refused by the allowlist. A blacklist would have accepted it.

schema_semantic_roles.note: schema node semantic_role was already gated by a closed positive set, which is why it needed no repair

schema_class_ceiling.withdrawal_reason: This tranche excludes OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEX, OBJECTIVE_POSITION and OBJECTIVE_OPPORTUNITY, so admitting an actor-named result class was incoherent with the role ceiling.
schema_class_ceiling.enforcement: author_governed_rule refuses a binding whose result_schema semantic_class is not the class authorized by the rule's family.

numeric_node_type.basis: TD_R03 §5/§8 place quantitative magnitude behind a nullable numeric-formula ref unset by default

structural_cardinality.scope_note: HQ211 Repair 1 scopes the prohibition to semantic VALUE and KIND leaves only. It does not abolish structural cardinality UNBOUNDED.

truthfulness_of_the_ceiling_claims.claim: V556_INTERACTION_RELATION and V556_ATTRACTOR_PREREQUISITE are lawfully valid-empty in this tranche
truthfulness_of_the_ceiling_claims.is_now_true_of: the machinery, at both authoring and registry build
truthfulness_of_the_ceiling_claims.evidence: the base court passed 92/92 at the repair base while the generic path could still populate both families; the repaired court refuses both and a hand-built GovernedRule is refused at build

no_architecture_reopen: Not required. No ceiling here conflicts with adopted authority; every ceiling is tranche-local authoring policy expressed as named data, not as an architectural constraint on the seam.
